verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a royalty-bearing model, not a royalty-free one. Community reports say Unreal is free only until a game earns $1,000,000, after which payment is owed (unreal-comm-3). One studio estimated Unreal would have cost a $3M-budget game about $150k (unreal-comm-4). The quoted license page lists only source access and 'all platforms & features', with no royalty-free or permissive terms, and source access is EULA/account-gated (unreal-docs-10, unreal-docs-18, unreal-probe-rt-1).
